title: Windows "SUCKS": How I'd Fix it by a retired Microsoft Windows engineer
summary: Dave Plummer, a retired Microsoft engineer who wrote Task Manager, responds to the claim that Windows sucks. He describes how he would fix common annoyances, in what he calls a love letter to Windows wrapped in a rant.
why: HN people share it in Windows 11 backlash threads as an even-handed insider's view of what is wrong with Windows.

quote.text: I find this take (from the guy who wrote the Windows task manager while at Microsoft) to be evenhanded.
